job.location: 100% remote contractor, United States preferred, US Central collaboration
job.rawJd: About the job: Oktana helps companies prepare for AI through project delivery, staff augmentation, Salesforce, MuleSoft, Snowflake, and modern product development. This is a 100% remote contractor position collaborating with distributed U.S. teams on digital products used by millions. Oktana is seeking a UX Designer for a long-term project improving messaging experiences across mobile and web. The designer will shape messaging products connecting job seekers and employers, including intuitive, data-driven, and AI-powered messaging experiences, while collaborating with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Legal, and other stakeholders. Responsibilities include designing end-to-end messaging experiences across mobile and desktop; creating user journeys, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma; improving reply prompts, conversation transparency, status updates, and re-engagement patterns; designing complex workflows, search, filtering, and data-heavy interfaces; incorporating qualitative research and user feedback; validating decisions through usability testing, A/B testing, and research insights; working within an established design system; and presenting design solutions and rationale. Must-haves: 3+ years of professional Product UX Design experience as an individual contributor; a strong end-to-end UX portfolio; complex enterprise or data-heavy product experience; strong Figma proficiency and handoff workflows; established design-system experience; cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and Legal; independent delivery with minimal supervision; research-led iteration; and advanced English. Nice-to-haves: messaging, inbox, communication, or notification products; accessibility and WCAG; international or localized products, especially Japan; mobile-first product design; A/B testing; and contractor or embedded-designer experience. Project: Enterprise Messaging Platform. Work model: 100% remote contractor. Preferred region: United States. Time zone: US Central. Advanced English required.
